title: Thai Temple (Wat)
paragraphs: Thailand has tens of thousands of Buddhist temples, known as wats, serving as religious, cultural, and community centers. Many feature ornate roofs, gilded stupas, and serene Buddha images.
Famous sites include Wat Phra Kaew in Bangkok and Wat Phra That Doi Suthep in Chiang Mai. Visitors typically dress modestly and remove shoes as a sign of respect.
